overview_description.description: Upgrade is a fintech company that offers mobile banking, credit, and payment products to mainstream consumers. Its product suite includes personal loans, home improvement financing, auto loans or auto refinancing, and credit cards that can be converted into fixed-rate installment plans. It also offers high-yield savings / rewards checking accounts, credit monitoring, and educational tools to help users understand and manage their credit. The company provides “Upgrade Shopping” which gives cashback at participating merchants, supplementing its card reward programs.
